name: hxn-window
description: Windowing and surfaces for Haxe: windows, input, monitors and native handles for rendering
releasenote: Export android_main, which a NativeActivity calls, so hxn build makes an Android app with a window, for arm64 and x86-64. The app runs in its data directory, which holds the files of its APK. hxn_android_context gives other libraries the JavaVM and the activity. Needs hxn 0.3.11.
